name: feature.campaign-brief.nodes
description: Personas & Campaign Brief node pack — validate a brief (compute the enabled channel set) and generate the messaging kernel (the shared strategic foundation every channel echoes), grounding it in the knowledge base (kb.rag) + brand voice (ctx.features.brand) via the run-scoped provider. Drives the Campaign Studio orchestration.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Campaign Brief: Get
nodes.description: Read a campaign brief's full body (including the messaging kernel) so revisions ground on the real brief instead of a validate summary. Read-only.

nodes.label: Brief: Validate
nodes.description: Validates a campaign brief's completeness and computes the enabled channel set over ctx.features['campaign-brief']. Inputs: { briefId }. Output: { valid, issues, enabledChannels }.

nodes.label: Brief: Generate Messaging Kernel
nodes.description: Generates the messaging kernel (headline, supporting statement, proof points, CTAs, tone) for a brief — grounded in the KB (kb.rag citations) and the brand voice (ctx.features.brand.resolve-voice), via the run-scoped ctx.callAI — then persists it on the brief. Inputs: { briefId, provider?, model? }. Output: { kernel }. ADR 1020 D8: with config.stageKernel the kernel is NOT saved here; it is returned (with briefVersion) for the approval, and promote-kernel saves it afterwards. Without the flag (older chains) it is saved as before. The kernel must carry a non-empty headline, supporting statement, primary CTA, tone and at least one proof point, after one repair.

nodes.label: Brief: Promote Kernel
nodes.description: ADR 1020 D8: saves an APPROVED messaging kernel onto the brief, after the approval (a rejection never reaches it). Inputs: { briefId, kernel, briefVersion }. Refuses brief_changed when the brief was edited after the kernel was generated. Output: { kernel, briefStatus }. role:"side-effect": a replay fork serves the recorded outcome instead of writing an old kernel over the current one.

nodes.label: Brief: Extract Seeds from KB
nodes.description: Proposes personas/product/competitors from the bound knowledge collection with source citations (PROPOSALS — user confirms; ADR 0356 P3). Inputs: { orgId, collectionId, query?, provider?, model? }. ADR 1020 D12: empty proposals fail generation_empty after one repair; each persona's sources map to sourceDocIds.

nodes.label: Brief: Extract VOC Evidence
nodes.description: Extracts verbatim voice-of-customer quotes (pain/desire/objection/praise) from the brief's bound KB collection and persists them as citation-carrying evidence — the node builds every sourceRef from the retrieved chunk (documentId + locator + sha256 contentHash) and verifies quotes verbatim; ungrounded candidates are dropped with findings and an all-dropped extraction is a typed failure (ADR 0403 P1). Inputs: { briefId, collectionId?, query?, topK?, provider?, model? }. ADR 1020 D9: role side-effect, because it writes the brief's research. It is held on the AI invocation log, not served: a replay fork re-runs it with the model call answered from the log, so its write runs again. Evidence and angle ids are content-derived (put-if-absent), so the repeat adds no duplicate, but it can bring back an item deleted while curating; the targeting pack is an upsert per platform, so a fork re-writes it (CS70WF-37).

nodes.label: Brief: Generate Ad Angles
nodes.description: Generates positioning angles from the messaging kernel + the brief's stored VOC evidence — the model cites evidence by index, the node maps indexes to stored evidence ids, and the surface re-validates every proofRef closed-world; an angle with no resolvable proof is dropped with a finding and an all-dropped generation is a typed failure. Hook variants project into the ORG hook bank as candidate hooks (deterministic ids, idempotent, never demoting). Requires a kernel + stored evidence (ADR 0403 P2). Inputs: { briefId, personaId?, provider?, model? }. ADR 1020 D9: role side-effect, because it writes the brief's research. It is held on the AI invocation log, not served: a replay fork re-runs it with the model call answered from the log, so its write runs again. Evidence and angle ids are content-derived (put-if-absent), so the repeat adds no duplicate, but it can bring back an item deleted while curating; the targeting pack is an upsert per platform, so a fork re-writes it (CS70WF-37).

nodes.label: Brief: Build Targeting Pack
nodes.description: Builds THE platform targeting pack (meta|google|linkedin|tiktok) for a brief — audiences, interests, keywords with a rationale citing the VOC evidence they derive from (model cites indexes, node maps to ids, surface re-validates). Deterministic brief+platform upsert: a re-run replaces, never duplicates. Requires stored evidence (ADR 0403 P3). Inputs: { briefId, platform, provider?, model? }. ADR 1020 D9: role side-effect, because it writes the brief's research. It is held on the AI invocation log, not served: a replay fork re-runs it with the model call answered from the log, so its write runs again. Evidence and angle ids are content-derived (put-if-absent), so the repeat adds no duplicate, but it can bring back an item deleted while curating; the targeting pack is an upsert per platform, so a fork re-writes it (CS70WF-37).

nodes.label: Campaign Brief: List Personas
nodes.description: Lists the workspace's personas over ctx.features['campaign-brief'] (tenant-scoped read; optional org/brand filter). Inputs: { orgId?, brandId? }. Output: { personas }.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief: List Briefs
nodes.description: Lists campaign briefs over ctx.features['campaign-brief'] (tenant-scoped read). Inputs: { orgId? }. Output: { briefs }.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief: List Angles
nodes.description: Lists a brief's persisted ad angles (ADR 0403) — tenant-scoped read. Inputs: { briefId }. Output: { angles }.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief: List Hooks
nodes.description: Reads the org hook bank (ADR 0403; promotion stays a route-only human write). Inputs: { orgId, status? }. Output: { hooks }.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief: Get Targeting Pack
nodes.description: Fetches one brief+platform targeting pack (ADR 0403; unknown platform reads as null). Inputs: { briefId, platform }. Output: { pack }.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief: List Targeting Packs
nodes.description: Lists a brief's targeting packs across platforms (ADR 0403) — tenant-scoped read. Inputs: { briefId }. Output: { packs }.
